CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer of $100.00 from checking to Alice is complete. Transfer ID: transfer-001.
CUSTOMER: I never saw a confirmation. Please send the $100.00 to Alice again.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfer history, and the $100.00 transfer from checking to Alice is already completed. It is transfer ID transfer-001, so the money has been sent. I have not sent a second payment, to avoid paying Alice twice. If you want to send another $100.00 to Alice as a separate payment, reply and confirm, and I'll set it up. If you don't recognize transfer-001, please contact us right away so we can look into it.
